subtitle: Official Android Application for Staff & Field Operations
changelog: v1.0.6: Official release with Audit Performance Fixes, Named Routing, and Dedicated Installer Dashboard
Parallelized 23 dashboard queries with Future.wait() for fast 1-2s loading times
Added Field Installer Dashboard with task statistics, unread badges, and task navigation
Added GoRouter named routes (/tasks, /customers, /notifications) for push notification deep-linking
Raised task list query limit from 100 to 500 to prevent data truncation
Fixed JVM heap & Gradle cache allocation settings for optimal build stability
